measurementMethod.transport: live Nebius Token Factory chat completions (OpenAI-compatible), temperature 0, response_format json_object, reasoning_effort low
measurementMethod.modelRouting: NEBIUS_MODEL_EXTRACTION env var (no vendor model-ID literals in source)
measurementMethod.runs: 24 single-pass decision calls (20 API 570 Table 1 fluid cases + 4 semantic-guard cases), 2026-10-19
measurementNotes: Verified quirk (v3.1 correction): guard-style evaluations emit >8k reasoning tokens under the visible-CoT accounting — a 2048-token max_completion_tokens budget returns EMPTY content with finish_reason 'length'. 6000 was sufficient for every call in this run; per-call headroom must stay generous.
One 17-minute upstream stall observed on 2026-10-19 during an earlier run — transport-level timeouts (90 s) plus bounded retry are mandatory for production fleet triage.
Ambiguous/mixed fluid cases trip the fail-closed inspector flag (confidence 0.65 and 0.75 < 0.85) — 2/2 ambiguous cases flagged.

Guard case 2 (p=0, expected grounded) is a model-side false negative: the narrative matched all facts and allowlisted citations but the semantic gate rejected it. Deterministic grounding layer accepts it; conservative gate costs recall, never precision.

cost.pricingSource: Nebius Token Factory public pricing, Nemotron-3.5 family (2026-10-19) — verify before benchmark reconciliation

results.note: model false negative — fail-closed, documented in measurementNotes
falsified t_required 8.05 vs computed 7.82 caught deterministically

fleetTriage.reason: deterministic pre-filter is pure TypeScript (zero model calls on deterministic failures); model calls reserved for genuinely ambiguous readings — hermetically tested in tests/decision/spikes.test.ts over the full 4,912-row register

schemaNote: nebiusMetrics mirrors Fork B lib/decision/benchmark/types.ts ProviderBenchmarkMetrics exactly (providerId, modelId, scenarioCount, attemptCount, successCount, failureCount, failureDiagnostics, latency{min,max,mean,p50,p90,p95,p99}Ms, calibration{brierScore, expectedCalibrationError, boundaryAccuracy}, cost{totalInputTokens, totalOutputTokens, estimatedCostPer1kUsd}). Extra keys (pricingPerMillionUsd, pricingSource, domainResults, measurementMethod) are documentation-only; Fork B's runner reads only the ProviderBenchmarkMetrics fields.
latencyCaveat: Measured single-pass latencies (p50 4.4 s) exceed the 100-300 ms handoff estimate: visible reasoning counts inside max_completion_tokens and dominates latency even at reasoning_effort low. Latency winners vs Fork B should be judged on this measured distribution, not the estimate.
